test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. I felt embarrassed as if I was somehow responsible for the fire in our home.

B. In my case, it was no different.

C. It always happens that bad news travels quickly.

D. Everyone in high school was aware of my plight.
solution:
The correct answer is '**CBDA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence C **will be the first sentence because it is an introductory general statement telling us that bad news travels quickly.
 
• After it, **Sentence B** will be used because it is the starting of an incident which tells us that in the author's case it was the same.
 
• **Sentence D **will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence and further tells us that everyone in his school was aware of his situation.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence A** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• ​**C**: It always happens that bad news travels quickly.
 
• **B**: In my case, it was no different.
 
• **D**: Everyone in high school was aware of my plight.
 
• **A**: I felt embarrassed as if I was somehow responsible for the fire in our home.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *It always happens that bad news travels quickly. In my case, it was no different. Everyone in high school was aware of my plight. I felt embarrassed as if I was somehow responsible for the fire in our home.*
